sources.chain: CBOE delayed quotes (cdn.cboe.com), morning run: bid, ask, OI, IV per contract
sources.implied_vol: each contract's own IV from the CBOE feed; market measure uses the at-the-money IV of the expiry; IV 30 interpolated between the expiries either side of 30 days
sources.historical_vol: 30-day realised vol from Yahoo daily closes with event days stripped (returns beyond 4 robust sigmas, at most two)
sources.earnings: earnings state, iv_em, then Yahoo's calendar; stocks with no known date are skipped

method: Tournament: the chart picks the structure (range -> iron condor with equal wings, bullish -> bull put spread, bearish -> bear call spread); shorts 25-45 delta, longs 5-20. EV = P(win) x average win - P(loss) x average loss at exits of 25, 18 and 10 DTE, after a quarter-spread slippage per leg in and out and $0.65 per contract per leg in and out. Ranked by EV on the stock's own (event-stripped) vol as a share of max loss; the market-probability EV is shown beside it. Proposed = implied vol above realised and positive EV.
